name: lan
description: The household network as seen from the PC itself, not from inside the container: use this for anything that needs real LAN presence. action 'arp' lists neighbours (ip, mac, state) - how to find a device's MAC; filter with ip or mac. 'wake' sends wake-on-LAN magic packets (give mac, or ip to look the MAC up). 'ping' one host. 'mdns' discovers services by type (service_type e.g. _googlecast._tcp.local, _airplay._tcp.local, _sonos._tcp.local, _hap._tcp.local, _printer._tcp.local; default lists all service types present) returning instance, host, ip, port, txt. 'ssdp' discovers UPnP devices (st e.g. ssdp:all, urn:schemas-upnp-org:device:MediaRenderer:1, roku:ecp, urn:dial-multiscreen-org:service:dial:1) returning ip, location, server. 'udp' sends a datagram (text or hex) to ip:port, optionally broadcast, and collects replies for wait_ms. Requires the lan-helper service on the Windows host; if unreachable, tell the owner to run lan-helper\install-lan-helper.ps1 once as administrator. Direct unicast HTTP/TCP to a device you already know does not need this tool.

mac.description: for wake, or to filter arp

ip.description: for wake/ping/udp, or to filter arp

service_type.description: mdns: the DNS-SD service type, e.g. _googlecast._tcp.local

hex.description: udp: payload as hex bytes (instead of text)

wait_ms.description: udp: collect replies for this long (max 5000)

timeout.description: seconds to listen for mdns/ssdp answers (default 3, max 10) or ping timeout
